title: Merge Streams

story.briefing: Two relays recorded the same window, each already in order. The archive wants one ordered stream, and re-sorting from scratch wastes what the relays already did.
story.success: Streams merged. The archive accepts a single ordered record.

description: Given two arrays each sorted in non-decreasing order, return a single array containing all their values in non-decreasing order. Duplicates are kept — if a value appears in both inputs, it appears twice in the output. Either array may be empty.
hints: Both inputs are already ordered, so the next value of the merged result is always one of two candidates: the front of one stream or the front of the other.
The fiddly part is what happens when one stream runs out. Handle that explicitly rather than hoping the comparison copes.
Keep an index into each array. While both have values left, append the smaller and advance that index. When one runs out, append everything remaining from the other.
